SQL:
SELECT
  CAST(ISODOW(orders.order_date) AS INT) AS "orders.isodow",
  orders.status AS "orders.status",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
FROM orders AS orders
WHERE
  orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  CAST(ISODOW(orders.order_date) AS INT),
  orders.status
ORDER BY
  "orders.isodow" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: 2025 revenue by weekday (Monday = 1 to Sunday = 7). Sunday was highest at 18,176.28 and Thursday lowest at 14,658.31. These totals include every order, whatever its status. The data has a 'bad' status that adds about 1.6k–2.2k per day. If you exclude those orders, the totals become: 1 = 15,878.48, 2 = 13,429.72, 3 = 14,383.65, 4 = 12,686.50, 5 = 14,639.87, 6 = 14,514.72, 7 = 16,033.79.
